headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Roborock RockMow robot lawn mowers.

pollInterval.title: Cloud refresh interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Live state arrives by push; this only re-syncs with the Roborock cloud as a safety net. Roborock limits this call, keep it at an hour or more.

exposeAttention.title: Needs Attention sensor
exposeAttention.description: Opens when the mower reports an error or its STOP button was pressed. Turn on notifications for it in the Home app.

exposeControls.title: Control switches (Mow, Pause)
exposeControls.description: Adds Mow and Pause switches. Off by default: a Home scene or 'Hey Siri, turn everything on' flips every switch, which would start the mower.

sensorDebounceSeconds.title: Sensor debounce (seconds)
sensorDebounceSeconds.description: How long a state must hold before its sensor flips. Faults and battery are reported immediately.
